_readme: Wording for the questionnaire. You can edit labels and help text freely. Keep the ids: the app uses them to decide what each answer does (see docs/HOW_SCORING_WORKS.md).

questions.label: Who would be relocating with you?
questions.help: This shapes the notes we show you. It never changes a score.

questions.label: Which age group are you in?
questions.help: Optional. Each age group on our team built its own research model. We only use yours if you skip ranking your priorities.

questions.label: What are you hoping for in your next home?
questions.help: We'll point you to the housing measures that matter for your plan. No bonus points either way.

options.label: A larger home with more space

questions.label: Pick your top three, in order.
questions.help: Tap the most important first. Tap again to remove.

questions.label: How much does your first choice outweigh the rest?
What weather would you enjoy?
questions.help: You ranked weather, so tell us what good weather means to you.

questions.label: What would be hardest for you to compromise on?
questions.help: We'll check this for all five cities and show you the numbers. Nothing gets removed.
